text:
Ava: Uploaded a trimmed launch blog draft focused on customer scenarios + short benchmark panel. URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-slim-v1
Marco: reading now. do we have final hero art? need 1200x630 and a square for socials.
Ava: @Marco can you produce both and include alt text? keep alt concise.
Marco: done. alt text: 'Redwood dashboard showing latency vs throughput'. exported 1200x630 and 800x800.
Jen: legal quick pass 1: avoid absolutes like "fastest"; 2: add short methodology link for the benchmark sentence; 3: include GDPR consent copy on the webinar form.
Ava: will swap wording and add a privacy line.
Priya: for CTAs I propose two hero buttons: A) Register Webinar B) View Benchmarks. Also a body CTA: Request a Demo.
Olivia: mapping to HubSpot lists: A -> Launch_Webinar, B -> Bench_Readers, C -> Demo_Requests. Need IDs and redirect hooks. utm scheme: utm_source=redwood_blog, utm_campaign=launch_s23, utm_content=ctaA|ctaB|ctaC
Tom: creating lists now. will DM IDs and set up redirect endpoints to capture utm_content. ETA tomorrow AM.
Ava: can we test CTA copy variants? I want Register vs Save Your Seat for hero.
Marco: will mock both in hero art; include hover states.
Jen: legal note on benchmarks: add a short footnote about test harness and model config. nothing public-sensitive, just reproducibility.
Ava: adding a tiny appendix with config snippet and a disclosure line.
Priya: timeline: final copy by Wed 5pm PT, assets by Thu noon, legal signoff Thu 2pm, staging preview Fri. everyone ok?
Tom: yes for back-end hooks.
Marco: assets on track for Thu noon.
Jen: legal aims for Thu 2pm if copy is in by Wed evening.
Olivia: I'll prep the registration page and GA events.
Ava: PublishBot, can you create a staging preview once assets and hubspot hooks are live?
PublishBot: preview scheduled. auto-create when you tag /preview in the doc and assets exist: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/launch-1924681234 :white_check_mark:
Ava: perfect. drop any last copy notes here and I'll create the publish ticket once we have legal thumbs. :rocket:
